title: NoCobbleBadges
description: This data pack removes all the default badges in my CobbleBadges mod
body:
This data pack removes all default badges in my mod [CobbleBadges](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblebadges2), perfect if you only want your own badges!

**Dependencies**
- [CobbleBadges](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblebadges2)
